#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <utility>
#include <algorithm>
#include <numeric>
#include <functional>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

const int N = 510;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
#define mp make_pair
#define fi first
#define se second

int n, m, mod;
array<array<int, N>, N> C;
array<array<pii, N>, N> dp;

int add(int a, int b) {
	return (a + b >= mod) ? a + b - mod : a + b;
}

pii operator+(const pii& a, const pii& b) {
	return mp(add(a.fi, b.fi), add(a.se, b.se));
}

pii operator*(const pii& a, const pii& b) {
	return mp(1LL * a.fi * b.fi % mod, (1LL * a.fi * b.se + 1LL * a.se * b.fi) % mod);
}

int s1(int l, int r) {
	return (l + r) * (r - l + 1) / 2;
}

int main() {
	ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
	cin.tie(nullptr);
	cin >> n >> m >> mod;
	for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
		C[i][0] = 1;
		for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
			C[i][j] = add(C[i - 1][j], C[i - 1][j - 1]);
		}
	}
	for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
		dp[i][0] = mp(1, 0);
		for (int j = 1; j <= i && j <= m; ++j) {
			if (i != j) {
				for (int k = 1; k <= i; ++k) {
					dp[i][j] = dp[i][j] + dp[k - 1][k - 1] * dp[i - k][j - k + 1] * mp(C[j][k - 1], 0);
				}
			}
			else {
				for (int k = 1; k <= i; ++k) {
					dp[i][j] = dp[i][j] + dp[k - 1][k - 1] * dp[i - k][i - k] * mp(C[i - 1][k - 1], 0) * mp(i + 1, k * k - s1(1, k) + s1(k + 1, i) - k * (i - k));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	cout << dp[n][m].se;
	return 0;
}
